claim_boundary: Exact conditional finite-graph Bradley-Terry quotient and fresh one-cycle calibration; not unconditional goodness-of-fit, positive scalarity certification, dependent or unknown-link behavior, general IRL, or ASMP-9 resolution.

power_calibration.nonmonotonicity_warning: Exact-size conditional power need not increase between adjacent per-edge sample counts; registered n values are calibration points, not critical thresholds.
